sessionTitle: Build collaborative agents into apps with APIs

announcements.name: Omniagent API runs at one cent per render minute
announcements.shortDescription: When bringing your own LLM, pricing is roughly 20 times cheaper than alternatives, making a five-minute call cost five cents and an eight-hour agent under $5 per day.
announcements.longDescription: The Omniagent API runs at only one cent per render minute when you bring your own LLM, which is roughly 20 times cheaper than the alternatives. At that rate, a five-minute customer call costs five cents and a full-time agent running eight hours a day costs less than $5. According to the speaker, this cost shift makes real-time multimodal video agents a production tool rather than a proof of concept.

announcements.name: Fully Azure-native architecture
announcements.shortDescription: The browser SDK connects over HTTPS and WebRTC through Azure Front Door, with core pods on Azure Kubernetes Service and rendering on dedicated Azure VM clusters, all on managed services.
announcements.longDescription: The Omniagent API is Azure Native: the browser-side SDK opens an HTTPS and WebRTC connection through Azure's Front Door and load balancing solutions, with private endpoint support in the network stack. Omniagent core pods run auto-scaled in Azure Kubernetes Service, the orchestration layer can talk to your own Azure OpenAI deployment or theirs, and the real-time multimodal rendering pipeline runs on dedicated Azure VM clusters streaming synchronized video back over WebRTC. Every component in the stack runs on an Azure managed service.

announcements.name: Single cloud billing and inherited governance
announcements.shortDescription: The service appears as a line item on the existing Azure invoice and works with existing Azure Policy, Defender, and DDoS protection.
announcements.longDescription: Omniagent delivers single cloud billing, where the line item shows up on your existing Azure invoice with no separate purchase, vendor, or bill. Existing governance policies just keep working, so the same Azure Policy, Defender, and DDoS protection you already have applies to it. It is provisioned directly from the Azure portal the same way you'd create a Cosmos DB or any other Azure resource.

announcements.name: Multi-provider LLM support
announcements.shortDescription: Swapping LLM providers is a configuration change rather than a rewrite, using the same agent configuration.
announcements.longDescription: Omniagent provides multi-provider support, letting you bring whichever LLM you've already deployed. Swapping providers is a key change rather than a rewrite, using the same agent configuration either way. The speaker cites Siemens as a key deployment where field service technicians interact with manufacturing systems through voice and video, with the same architecture running customer service, sales onboarding, and corporate training.

announcements.name: Cross-channel memory
announcements.shortDescription: When enabled per session, the agent extracts facts and carries context across web, phone, and text so users do not re-explain.
announcements.longDescription: Memory can be turned on at the channel layer: when you start a session for a user, you tell the Omniagent API to remember, and from that point the agent extracts facts, summarizes conversations, and carries that context forward automatically. Memory follows the user across every channel, so a conversation can start in a web app, continue on the phone, and be picked up over text the next morning. The result is the same agent with the same context and no re-explaining.

announcements.name: Available today on Azure with a sub-15-minute quickstart
announcements.shortDescription: The resource is provisioned from the portal like any other Azure resource.
announcements.longDescription: The Omniagent platform is available today on Azure, provisioned from the portal the same way you'd provision any other Azure resource. Once signed up, the quickstart gets you to a running agent in under 15 minutes, and you can bring your existing Azure OpenAI deployment to get started. The speaker also invites Build attendees to visit the booth to build a co-worker live.
